summary: Avnet, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the pricing of a $550 million public offering of 5.650% Notes due 2031 under an existing S-3 shelf registration. The company will use net proceeds to repay borrowings under its revolving credit facility and accounts receivable securitization program. The notes are senior unsecured obligations ranking equally with existing debt, issued under a 2010 indenture with Computershare Trust as trustee. The underwritten offering, dated August 19, 2026, is expected to close August 24, 2026. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation.
